hero.title: We build AI for the businesses that build everything else.
hero.subtitle: Infanina is a small studio of engineers, designers and ML practitioners based in Singapore. We work alongside SMEs and growing teams across South-East Asia.

story.title: Most AI never makes it to production.
story.body_1: We kept seeing the same pattern: companies excited by AI demos, six months later sitting on prototypes that never reached a customer. The gap was rarely about the model — it was about engineering, integration, and the unglamorous work of running things in production.
story.body_2: So we built Infanina to focus on that gap. We pick projects where AI clearly moves the needle, design honestly, and ship with the same care a serious team would give any other piece of business-critical software.

principles.title: Three things we don't compromise on.

honest.title: Honest scoping
honest.desc: If a project doesn't need AI, we'll say so. If it does, we'll be specific about what changes and what doesn't.

owned.title: You own everything
owned.desc: Code, data, prompts, evals — yours. No black-box platforms you can't leave.

production.title: Production-first
production.desc: Every system ships with monitoring, evals and a clear cost ceiling on day one.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains how Infanina Pte Ltd ("Infanina", "we") collects, uses and protects personal data when you visit our website or engage our services.

sections.collection_body: When you contact us, we collect the information you provide — typically name, email, company and the description of your project. We do not use third-party advertising trackers on this site.
sections.use_body: We use your information solely to respond to your enquiry and to provide services you've engaged us for. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for marketing.
sections.retention_body: We retain enquiry data for up to 24 months unless you ask us to delete it sooner.
sections.rights_body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data we hold about you by writing to hello@infanina.com.
sections.contact_body: Email hello@infanina.com if anything here is unclear.
